ChatGPT types as you talk

18 November 2026 · Reading time: 2 minutes

OpenAI has launched Live Dictation in ChatGPT. Your speech now turns into text while you talk, and the 10-minute recording limit is gone.

Sapaude retells the story in its own words. The source is below. Publisher: Sapaude.

In three points

Three points, in this order: what the source shows, where that claim stops, and what to check next.

  1. Until now, dictated text appeared only after the recording was transcribed. With Live Dictation, OpenAI says, you spend less time waiting for your message.
  2. Tapping or clicking the waveform shows or hides the text as it appears.
  3. Live Dictation is rolling out globally to all ChatGPT plans on iOS, Android, the web and the desktop app.

Text while you speak

OpenAI announced Live Dictation for ChatGPT in its release notes on November 18, 2026. "Dictation in ChatGPT is getting faster and more reliable," the company writes. With the new mode, speech turns into text as you talk, so you spend less time waiting for a message to finish transcribing.

Show or hide the text

While you dictate, the waveform doubles as a switch. A tap or click shows the text as it is written, or hides it again if you would rather just talk.

No more 10-minute cap

OpenAI has also removed the 10-minute recording limit, so long voice notes or briefs no longer have to be split into several messages.

Where it is available

Live Dictation is rolling out globally to all ChatGPT plans, free ones included, on iOS, Android, the web and the desktop app. The release notes do not say how accurate the new mode is or which speech model it uses. The same day, OpenAI also listed an Accounting plugin for the desktop app that helps reconcile transactions and prepare month-end reports.

What you can do

Dictation in ChatGPT gets faster and works for long messages without a time cap. The release notes give no accuracy figures.

In the app, the same story is also told shorter and in more detail, matched to your level.

Source: OpenAI. Published: 18 November 2026.
